nom: Drunk Elephant C-Tango Multivitamin Eye Cream

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin or sensitive eye area report mixed results: some describe burning, puffiness, or irritation, while others (including one who names sensitive skin explicitly) say it caused no irritation and was gentle.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 40s to 70s report reduced puffiness, brighter under-eyes, and firmer-looking lids, though one reviewer feels her wrinkles got more visible on this product.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report smoother texture, reduced fine lines, and firmer or tighter-looking under-eye skin over weeks of use; a few report the opposite, saying wrinkles became more visible or the product did nothing for firmness.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the cream as moisturizing or hydrating for the under-eye area, with several noting it is lightweight rather than heavy; a couple say it is only mildly moisturizing or not moisturizing enough for their needs.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers mention burning, stinging, or irritation especially when applied too close to the eye or on compromised skin, while others explicitly say it caused no irritation even on sensitive eyes.
concerns.barrier: Some reviewers note the product sinks in well and pairs smoothly with other skincare, but a notable subset reports pilling when layered with other products.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report the product helped fade or lighten dark circles, sometimes within days to a couple of weeks; a smaller group reports no visible change in their dark circles despite consistent use.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports it cleared white bumps under the eyes that other creams caused; this is not corroborated by others.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers describe the formula as non-greasy and lightweight despite a thick texture; no reports of increased oiliness were found.

aspects.libelle: Pilling when layered with other products
Burning or stinging near the eye
Small amount goes a long way
High price relative to product amount

extraits.texte: I have bad under eye bags and sensitive skin and have been trying to find a good eye cream and was hopeful with drunk elephant but it made under my eyes burn. It is not good for sensitive skin! Not drunk elephants best. 😭😔

Wowzers…. This is the only lotion/cream/treatment that has worked for me in the past 10 years & ive only had it on my eyes for 3 hours. My dark circles are now a baby pink which is good for my eyes, my lids and the fine skin under my eyes is actually noticeably tightened/lifted & moisturized! The lotion goes into the skin & doesn't just sit on top! The price doesn't bother me as I have spent a good amount of $ on eye products that are bogous and this product is definitely quality, worth the price to me! P.s.- i have sensitive eyes and this product didn't irrate my skin!! My results were literally same day, i put this on 3 hours ago & my eyes look completely different!! I cant wait to see if my results improve or at least stay consistent throughout use!

49 year old eyes with dark circles underneath. This is the first cream I have tried that is gentle yet works. Not greasy. Sinks right in and makeup goes great over it. I use it morning and night. I was loyal to Tatcha, but have switched all of my skincare products over to Drunk Elephant.

This eye cream is the first Drunk Elephant product that I tried, a free sample from Sephora, and I can't tell you how much I loved it. I immediately went back to the store and bought a full size version. After using it for nearly 6 months, I can tell you it's a must have product for me. It's so moisturizing and really feels wonderful under my eyes. I've seen a nice difference on the skin around my eyes. I have very sensitve skin, but have had no problems with this eye cream and you really don't have to use a lot (meaning you don't have to spend a lot for constant refills). Will definitely buy again and again.

extraits.titre: Noticeable Difference in Texture on My Eyes
extraits.texte: I bought this in August of 2023 (And it's still lasted me to February of 2024!) over concerns of crepe-y skin on my eyes. I have noticed a difference in the texture and firmness of my eyelids after using this product throughout the months. I remember applying eyeshadow and seeing all the fine lines, and they have greatly reduced over time. I don't think I ever really had a problem with dark circles so I can't speak to it's affect on pigmentation. Also I don't use this product daily. I use it maybe every other day, and I use half a pump at a time because I feel that that's enough. So your mileage may vary regarding product lifespan. I would be careful with this product if your eye area is sensitive however. Basically any time I applied this when I had tender skin around my eyes from using a makeup wipe or crying too hard (like we do sometimes lol), it would result in puffiness and sometimes even mucus forming from my eyes. So I would recommend skipping this product for the day/night if you know your eye area is a bit compromised and opt for a more soothing option instead to avoid irritation. So really if I could, I would rate this 4.5 stars because of that one thing. But I do consider that to be a bit of user error on my part, and the good results I've had from this product out weight the negatives.

I had high hopes for this product. The pump for the bottle is very convenient, application is easy, product doesn't have an overwhelming scent. Overall, it did not work for me. I felt that it made my wrinkles even more visible (and maybe added more), so it looks like i'm aging 100x quicker; I'm only 29. I used it for about 2+ months, but I stopped…

extraits.titre: Pills if layered with other products
extraits.texte: This is my first eye cream purchase in a long time, so im testing what works for me and what doesnt. First thing I noticed was that the packaging is nice, the cream is thick, you need less than a pea size amount per eye. However, if you layer with other facial products, this products can pill if not absorbed all the way into skin.
